name: Option Event Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of event for an option.

CLST.name: Close Out
CLST.definition: Notice of a close out of the position.

KNIN.name: Knock In
KNIN.definition: Notice of a knock-in. The option has a specified spot level, which, if touched during the knock-in period, triggers the option into existence. Prior to that level being touched, no option exists.

KNOC.name: Knock Out
KNOC.definition: Notice of a knock-out. The option has a specified spot level, which, if touched during the knock-out period, terminates the option.
